task: Compute Indian income tax under the new tax regime for FY 2024-25 for three salaried people with gross salaries A = Rs 7,20,000, B = Rs 7,90,000 and C = Rs 18,50,000. Use exactly these rules: (1) taxable income = gross salary - standard deduction of Rs 75,000. (2) Slab rates on taxable income: up to 3,00,000: 0%; 3,00,001-7,00,000: 5%; 7,00,001-10,00,000: 10%; 10,00,001-12,00,000: 15%; 12,00,001-15,00,000: 20%; above 15,00,000: 30%. (3) Rebate u/s 87A: if taxable income <= 7,00,000 the tax is zero. (4) Marginal relief: if taxable income exceeds 7,00,000, the tax before cess cannot exceed (taxable income - 7,00,000). (5) Add 4% health and education cess on the tax after rebate/relief. (6) No surcharge and no other deductions. Report each person's total tax including cess, rounded to the nearest rupee, and C's effective tax rate as a percentage of gross salary (2 decimals). RESULT keys: tax_a, tax_b, tax_c, effective_rate_c_pct.

Finally, add 4% cess on the tax after rebate/relief. I will assert that tax after rebate/relief is never more than taxable_income - 700000 for incomes above 700000, and that the rebate sets tax to zero for incomes <= 700000. Also, I will verify effective_rate_c_pct is consistent with tax_c and gross salary C.

attempts.llm_code:
def compute_tax(gross_salary):
    standard_deduction = 75000
    taxable_income = gross_salary - standard_deduction
    slabs = [(300000, 0.0), (700000, 0.05), (1000000, 0.10), (1200000, 0.15), (1500000, 0.20), (float('inf'), 0.30)]

    # Calculate tax before rebate and marginal relief
    tax = 0.0
    prev_limit = 0
    for limit, rate in slabs:
        if taxable_income <= prev_limit:
            break
        income_in_slab = min(taxable_income, limit) - prev_limit
        tax += income_in_slab * rate
        prev_limit = limit

    # Apply rebate u/s 87A
    if taxable_income <= 700000:
        tax_after_rebate = 0.0
    else:
        tax_after_rebate = tax

    # Apply marginal relief if taxable_income > 700000
    if taxable_income > 700000:
        marginal_relief_limit = taxable_income - 700000
        if tax_after_rebate > marginal_relief_limit:
            tax_after_relief = marginal_relief_limit
        else:
            tax_after_relief = tax_after_rebate
    else:
        tax_after_relief = tax_after_rebate

    # Add 4% cess
    total_tax = tax_after_relief * 1.04

    return taxable_income, tax, tax_after_rebate, tax_after_relief, total_tax

A = 720000
B = 790000
C = 1850000

# Compute taxes
(taxable_a, tax_a_before, tax_a_rebate, tax_a_relief, tax_a_total) = compute_tax(A)

# Effective tax rate for C
effective_rate_c = (tax_c_total / C) * 100

assert (taxable_b <= 700000 and abs(tax_b_rebate) < 1e-6) or (taxable_b > 700000 and tax_b_rebate == tax_b_before), f"Rebate check failed for B: taxable_income={taxable_b}, tax_before={tax_b_before}, tax_after_rebate={tax_b_rebate}"
assert (taxable_c <= 700000 and abs(tax_c_rebate) < 1e-6) or (taxable_c > 700000 and tax_c_rebate == tax_c_before), f"Rebate check failed for C: taxable_income={taxable_c}, tax_before={tax_c_before}, tax_after_rebate={tax_c_rebate}"

if taxable_a > 700000:
